summary: Comprehensive testing of Faithful Threads e-commerce platform completed. All backend APIs (21 tests) passed. Frontend UI testing verified homepage, shop page (33 products), category filtering, admin login, admin dashboard with stats, admin products page, product detail page, and shopping cart functionality.

integration_issues.issue: After admin login, user is redirected to homepage instead of admin dashboard. User needs to manually navigate to /admin

action_items: Consider redirecting admin users to /admin dashboard after login instead of homepage
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - existing data used for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core features verified working: 33 products (12 original + 1 existing Gildan + 20 new Gildan imports), admin dashboard shows correct stats (33 products, 3 orders, 5 customers, $59.98 revenue), category filtering works (24 T-Shirts, 3 Hoodies, 3 Hats, 3 Mugs), product search works, product detail page with color/size selection works, add to cart functionality works. Square payment is in DEMO MODE.

backend_apis: GET /api/admin/stats - returns correct stats (33 products, 3 orders, 5 customers)
frontend_pages: Homepage - loads correctly with hero section and categories
Shop page - displays 33 products with filtering and search
Admin Dashboard - shows stats (33 products, 3 orders, 5 customers, $59.98 revenue, 2 pending orders)
Admin Products - displays all 33 products with search functionality
Product Detail - shows product info, colors, sizes, stock, add to cart
Shopping Cart - items added correctly with subtotal calculation

mocked_apis.Square Payment Gateway: Processes payments in demo mode without real transactions
